title: slot reset
description: Return a slot to a clean base branch @ origin/<base> (to reuse a merged one). Refuses a live-locked or dirty slot, or one with a turn in flight, unless force=true. The worker (conversation) survives a reset; hard-worker=true clears it too, so the next dispatch starts a fresh conversation.

hard-worker.description: also clear the slot's worker (conversation identity) - fresh worker on next dispatch
